title: Lost Mary Maryliq Pink Lemonade 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Experience all-day vaping satisfaction and flavour with Maryliq Nic Salts. Satisfy your thirst for a classic summertime favourite with Lost Mary Maryliq's Pink Lemonade. This e-liquid captures the nostalgia of sipping a chilled glass of pink lemonade on a hot day. Each inhale offers a harmonious blend of zesty Lemon and a subtle touch of Red Berries, delivering a vibrant yet comforting flavour profile. Ideal for vapers who appreciate the simpler joys in life, Pink Lemonade provides an escape from the everyday hustle. The balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio ensures a smooth throat hit and rich clouds, capturing the essence of this much-loved beverage in every puff.
